pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with high-contrast, sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Patches are larger and more elongated on the lateral neck, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented geometric shapes toward the shoulder and chest.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. The negative-space graph shows clear 3-way and 4-way junction nodes with a relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the visible neck region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck. The mane displays a high-frequency jagged edge against the blurred background background.
